adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` are lowercased (`.map(...toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guest` values are compared without normalization (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), so case-variant emails can bypass the blacklist. The duplicate filter is also case-sensitive (`guest === attendee.email`), allowing the same mailbox to be added multiple times with different casing. Additionally, `isAttendee` uses a case-sensitive comparison (`attendee.email === user.email`), which can incorrectly deny/allow attendee-based permission depending on casing. These behaviors are directly verifiable from the diff and can lead to incorrect access control and data integrity issues.
